findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/PointsFunctor.lean:54` defines `HopfAlgebra.points` as `GrpCat.of (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))`; `FiniteTypeTrivial.lean:117-118` defines `trivial R` as `of R R`; existing replacements are at `Trivial.lean:52`, `:63`, `:69`, `:76`, `:93`, `:117`, and `:124`, while the new declarations at `FiniteTypeTrivial.lean:190-235` merely call those same names.
findings.fix: Remove lines 190-235 and use `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv`, `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv_apply`, `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply`, `TrivialGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue`, `TrivialGroup.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply`, `TrivialGroup.convPoint_eq_one`, and `TrivialGroup.convPoint_apply` directly; `HopfAlgebra.points (H := trivial R) A` unfolds to `WithConv (R →ₐ[R] A)`.
findings.issue: `trivialPointsMulEquiv` and its point/naturality lemmas duplicate the existing `TauCeti.TrivialGroup` API under a finite-type alias.

summary: The finite-type trivial object itself is new, but the added finite-type points API is a parallel public wrapper over the existing trivial-group points API after unfolding `HopfAlgebra.points` and `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.trivial`. Those declarations should be removed rather than duplicating the raw API under finite-type names.
